Name: Colored Honey Labels
Author: voltaek
Description:
This mod makes your honey bottles automatically have colored labels, lids, etc. on them. Just like other automatically-colored artisan items in Stardew Valley v1.6, the color is based on the type of honey it is, which depends on the flower that "flavored" the honey (if any) when it was harvested. For example, when you harvest a Blue Jazz Honey bottle it will have a blue label, lid, etc. on it.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Minimum of Stardew Valley v1.6.15 and SMAPI v4.1.10 are required.

If you are using a custom honey bottle sprite from another mod, this mod will likely override that back to showing the vanilla/base game honey bottle sprite, as this mod must add and use a custom texture in order to colorize and then overlay a colored label, lid, or both onto the honey bottle sprite.

Luckily, this mod has been built in a way to allow other mods to add their own custom honey sprites to the list of honey sprite options. You can then choose to use their sprite for honey items instead of any of this mod's built-in sprite options, while still having it get the same colored labels/lids/etc. applied to it. Essentially, they will just need to edit data about their honey sprite into the custom data asset dictionary this mod creates. Mod authors can reference the [url=https://github.com/voltaek/StardewMods/blob/main/ColoredHoneyLabels/README.md]Integration Docs[/url] and [url=https://github.com/voltaek/StardewMods/blob/main/ColoredHoneyLabels/ExampleIntegrationMods]Example Integration Mods[/url] on this mod's [url=https://github.com/voltaek/StardewMods]GitHub page[/url] for all the information needed to do so.

[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]
It is highly recommended to only change configuration options in-game via the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Manager[/url] menus due to the complex values used for the 'Honey Sprite' option.

[size=3]Options[/size]
[size=2][list]
[*][b]Honey Sprite[/b] - This represents your selected honey sprite from the list presented in the GMCM menu. See the 'Built-In Honey Sprite Options' image in the image gallery for examples of each. It should only really be changed through the GMCM interface since the values for this are not really user-friendly (they're long and easy to mistype) and vary depending on mod integrations. A blank or invalid value will be replaced with the value for the default "Full Label" honey sprite.
[*][b]More Label Color Variety[/b] - Enable this to slightly shift the label color of some honey types, resulting in a larger variety of label colors. Changing this value via GMCM will refresh all honey objects to match the new config value.
[/list][/size][b][size=5]Install & Uninstall[/size][/b]
This mod is safe to install or uninstall mid-save.

Honey items in an existing save will be converted to colored ones automatically when loading your save with this mod installed.

If you must uninstall, your existing colored honey items will appear as normal, uncolored honey items in your save afterwards. The only quirk you might notice is that previously colored honey items won't stack with newly created uncolored ones, but otherwise they'll be totally normal.

[size=4]Suggested Mod Pairings[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20493]Honey Harvest Predictor[/url] - A small mod that changes the icon shown in the bubble above ready-for-harvest bee houses so it shows what you'll harvest from it. When paired with Colored Honey Labels, you can change its configuration option so honey bottles with colored labels/lids/etc. will show instead of flowers.
